official_product_and_legal_original_chan.evidence: Surfshark's official Android page links its Download .APK button directly to downloads.surfshark.com and explicitly offers that APK alongside Google Play; it cautions against modded APKs. Its terms grant a license to download, install and use its software on a compatible device.
official_product_and_legal_original_chan.boundary: The vendor URL is moving; legal availability for use is not a grant to modify or redistribute it.

exact_package_and_version.evidence: Current original-file SHA equals G299 raw admission; independent G299 aapt2/apksigner/ZIP/ELF checks identify this exact package, version and ARM64 artifact.
exact_package_and_version.boundary: Google Play identity is package-level, not proof that Play serves these same direct-download bytes.

overseas_mainstream.evidence: The US-English Google Play listing for exact id=com.surfshark.vpnclient.android names Surfshark B.V. and shows 10M+ worldwide downloads and about 312K reviews; the US storefront is an overseas market signal.
overseas_mainstream.boundary: The worldwide lifetime bucket is neither US installs nor downloads of version 3.35.0.

complete_client_blackbox_source_boundary.evidence: The tested input is the unmodified executable Android APK, with no complete Android client source used by the project. Surfshark terms expressly license mobile/desktop software use while reserving the software and related IP to the publisher/licensors; component code or protocol documentation is not complete Android client source.
complete_client_blackbox_source_boundary.boundary: Terms support a proprietary product-level boundary, not proof that complete source for this exact build exists nowhere.

unmodified_project_input.evidence: G299 root admission accepts this original APK as unmodified; present SHA still matches and G300 made no APK/source edit.
unmodified_project_input.boundary: A later runtime copy needs its own SHA readback.

publisher_signer_binding: UNPROVEN: no independently publisher-published certificate fingerprint or publisher-signed exact APK digest. Embedded signing certificate DN fields are Unknown; HTTPS distribution and a Google Play developer name do not independently bind that cert to Surfshark B.V.
minimal_supplement: Obtain Surfshark's official Android signing-certificate SHA-256 or a publisher-signed exact-release checksum/key, then compare or verify against the retained original bytes. Repeating the TLS download alone is not independent signer attestation.
limits: No OH7/Bionic install, truly-cold start, screen, input or VPN-service test
No device, container, graph or Bridge command in G300
Root qualification decision and canonical count are separate
